ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB\parallel CD\parallel EF$. If $AC=6$, $CE=3$, and $DF=2$, what is the length of $BD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB\parallel CD\parallel EF$, \\
therefore $\frac{AC}{CE}=\frac{BD}{DF}$, \\
since $AC=6$, $CE=3$, $DF=2$, \\
therefore $\frac{6}{3}=\frac{BD}{2}$, \\
solving, we get: $BD=\boxed{4}$.
